audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags the level chart (Milio 7/7 stages) as contradicting the aggregate 53% Nautilus win rate.
audit.why: The page's prose (whys, spikes, early/mid/late) already agrees with the packet's own per-stage levelChart — both say Milio wins every lane stage via Q knockback disengage, W sustain, E shield, and R cleansing Depth Charge's stun — and each claim is grounded in a real, specific mechanic from enemyKit, not template filler. The 53% aggregate win rate is a whole-game figure and can reflect post-lane teamfighting/scaling rather than lane-stage momentum, so it does not by itself prove the per-stage chart wrong. I cannot confirm from the kit alone which figure should override the other.

Spikes correctly key Level 2 (Q hook answered by Milio's Q/W/E kit), Level 6 (Breath of Life cleanses Depth Charge's stun), first item (W sustain camp outpaces poke), and late (R cleanse + shields neutralize the single-target ult).

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were copy-pasted trade lines under titles ('Chain the carry through the refund', 'Anchor minions out of boredom') that promise different content.
audit.why: Milio's Warm Hugs (E) carries two charges (enemyKit E), a real resource Nautilus can bait out before committing, and Ultra Mega Fire Kick (Q) is a knockback that punishes a whiffed Nautilus Q by disengaging the hook — both are concrete, kit-grounded facts that fit the existing titles.
audit.corrected: dosFull[1].d now states the two-charge bait; dontsFull[2].d now states the whiffed-Q punish.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Warm Hugs carries two charges — burn both with early poke so his real engage has no shield left to spend.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Save the hook for a real all-in — Fire Kick punishes a whiffed Q by knocking you off target.

edits.before: - Milio Breath of Life: matchup-defining — The team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep W Titan's Wrath banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Milio Breath of Life (160/145/130s CD): matchup-defining — the team-wide cleanse-heal undoes your CC chain — force it early, engage after. - Keep W Titan's Wrath (12s CD) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
